purpose: One bounded SOURCE-only context-reading contrast, not another local RAW96 head variant. Existing DINO context+native role BCE acknowledged; learned query-conditioned read vs fixed bilinear read is the tested difference.
user_preference_pending_optional: No reply to balanced/visible/E-priority question; use balanced D/E as working assumption, not user approval or deployment requirement.
allowed_data: Only original MR6D public TRAIN151 inputs bound by ORIGINAL_TRAIN151_CONTEXT_INPUT_BINDINGS.jsonl. Select existing available weak D/E368 exactly; no new labels/reference quality promotion.
fixed_candidate_split: V225 candidate reused verbatim: FIT65=D57/E8 and DEV303=D267/E36. No alternative split search. C65 or project-trained warmstart forbidden.
data_authority: Weak associated native-role semantic D/E; actual physical coordinate quality unknown. Dev source reused/inspected, not fresh blind; not current223/publicheld performance.
encoder: Pinned official frozen DINOv2 vits14_reg4, metadata f433177089a681826f849f194ece3bb48f4d63fb38d32fc837e3dc7a4e5641fb. Shared target context224 from original q8 unexpanded minmax and local96 original q/L. No GT region, instance, pose, mask, native reference or recenter.
features: Frozen context CLS384, context256x384 patch tokens, local96-to224 DINO CLS384; original native/availability/relativeq condition32. Frozen encoder features may be computed for all selected rows; trainable fit and any learned normalization only FIT. Unit L2 per descriptor/token is per-row fixed math, not learned normalization.
CONTROL: Classifier input [local384,fixed-bilinear-query-context384,contextCLS384,condition32]. Bilinear border align_corners=False at original q in original contextbox. Single linear binary logit.
TREAT: Same classifier input and initialization, replace fixed bilinear context descriptor by learned softmax attention over all256 contextpatches. Query=Linear32to8(condition32), keys=Linear388to8([normalized patch384, patch_xy-active_q_xy and squared components4]); dot/sqrt8, softmax; weighted normalized patch descriptor. No hidden MLP, no changed input/query/target.
parameters: CONTROL identical module with unused attention parameters for same state shape; unused parameters disclosed. TREAT attention trained, all other features/loss/split same.

training.balanced_BCE: mean over D plus mean over E, divided2
training.L2_scope: sum of classifier and active attention parameter squares; CONTROL attention excluded as unused

reporting: Threshold logit0 fixed, D0/E1, no trained abstention; show CM/P/R/forced-binary U0 and class denominators; this does not solve abstention. Report all arms. No model selected from protected evaluations.

source_branch_pass_before_any_new_curren.interpretation: Only evidence to pursue source method, not goal success or independent practical performance. If fail, do not extend epochs/seeds or try nearby head variants in this branch.

scope.YCB_synthetic_goal_requirement: Remains unsatisfied by this diagnostic contrast; existing prior training/history retained. If this reading mechanism passes, correct-authority source teacher integration remains required.

execution_admission: Root design frozen; exact code/assets/data bindings and independent data scope verification required before feature/model payload access. No permission question needed under existing user goal authorization.
